items.name: the energy split: the L2 line energy against the per-op base
items.v3: b2 -88.9 and d2 -291.7 pJ a line (no bound), xi 0.000 at its lower bound; the L2 lines an op are nearly constant across the L2-served shapes (KB <= 2 and the c-arms; none at KB >= 3), so b2 + d2 phi trades with Eub, the gate and the data term

E1b.reading: no line costs negative energy; at the bound the L2 line is priced inside the per-op base

E1m.role: the tie to the energy manual
E1m.r_L2_label: desk: the energy manual's committed per-byte read prices, L2 4.051 over L3 10.849 pJ a byte over idle (memory_reads rows, measured 18 Sep 2026 on aifoundry2), a priori to every matmul fit

items.unchanged_in_every_form: xi free in [0, 1] (pinned 1 with no governed card in a fold), every other energy constant and pin as v3
rule: fit E1u, E1b, E1t and E1m on all the data and on every LOEO fold (and E210's), on the final time form's lines and op times, from the energy starts of item 5
score each by LOEO W over idle given the measured op time, rms of forecast / measured - 1 over the points all four price at 3 W or more, configuration twins excluded

among E1b, E1t, E1m: the candidates are the forms whose score lies within 0.10 points of the lowest of the three; of the candidates the form with the fewest free constants wins (E1t and E1m 24, E1b 26); at equal constants E1t before E1m
that winner enters v3.1 unless E1u's score is lower than the winner's by more than 0.30 points; then E1u enters and the split is reported as not identified (as in v3), the winner's figures beside

reported: all four forms LOEO and LOCO (both routes of item 2), with and without twins
b2, d2, xi per fold and their bound activity
the joules by class (L2 share) at E213 points

items.name: the energy scale of a card left out

anchor.point_definition: scored runs only (the sessions' smoke processes of that arm are not points); as v3.1's data loader reads them (v3's data_v3 extended): one energy point a (experiment, card, configuration), the mean of its runs; MM1-v3's table names them E206|p035, E206B|p035, E208|c1|..., E212|c1|..., E208|a2|..., E212|a2|..., E208|c0|..., E212|c0|... (gemmL1x1x4|int8|random|0xffffffff): aifoundry3 1, card 1 3, aifoundry2 2, card 0 2 points; a scored run of that configuration committed at GitHub main before the fit's start joins its card's anchor set
anchor.kc_from_anchor: W_i = D_i (R0_i + kc K1_i) at each anchor point i of the held-out card, its measured op time, volts and die (D_i the die factor, K1_i the kc-multiplied per-op term at kc 1, R0_i every other term with Pa = the training cards' mean); kc = sum w_i^2 D_i K1_i (W_i - D_i R0_i) / sum w_i^2 D_i^2 K1_i^2, w_i = 1 / max(W_i, 3 W): the energy fit's own weighted least squares, closed form, from the anchor alone
anchor.validity: kc inside [0.5, 2] and the kc-multiplied term's share of the predicted W at the solved kc, kc K1_i / (R0_i + kc K1_i), averaging at least 25% over the anchor points; otherwise that fold uses the fallback and is flagged
anchor.scoring: the held-out card's anchor points are left out of that fold's scored set under both routes (both routes scored on the same points); with them, REPORTED beside
anchor.a2_rescale_first: in the fold without aifoundry3 the forecast R0 + kc K1 is the same anywhere on the flat line but the solved kc is not, so that fold's fitted point is first rescaled exactly as AMENDMENT-A2.md does (the training cards' mean kc set to 1: every kc / s and the per-op constants Eub, a_op, a_lane, a8 and b0 x s, s the training cards' mean kc as fitted); only then is the held-out card's kc solved and the validity test applied, at that scale

items.fallback: MM1-v3's declared rule (a held-out card takes the training cards' mean Pa and kc 1) with AMENDMENT-A2's pin in the fold without aifoundry3 (the training cards' mean kc set to 1 by the exact rescaling of A2)
rule: v3.1's held-out-card energy route is the anchor route; the fallback applies in a fold where the held-out card has no anchor point or the validity test fails
every LOCO energy figure is computed and reported under both routes, for v3.1 and for v3 refitted
acceptance rule 2 (item 9) reads the anchor route for both models; the fallback's figures are printed beside
items.not_wanted_if: the anchor route's pooled LOCO W given t is higher than the fallback's (reported; the route stays as declared)
reported: per LOCO fold: kc from the anchor, kc under the fallback, the anchor points' residuals, both routes' rms and bias

items.name: gamma (the path's exposure) and T_coop (the cooperation cost)
items.v3: both pinned 0; D_A, D_B = the census path of the loop less rgm136 gemmL's (cycles / f), no fitted constant

definitions.dT_path: the census's D_A_cycles_vs_rgm136, D_B_cycles_vs_rgm136 (rgm136 gemmL 0/0; gemmLnc -12.5/-22.0; rgm211 gemmL -10.5/-13.75; rgm211 gemmLn -37.0/-49.75)
definitions.place: the operand's place in each op class of the map: L2, L3 or F (fresh); D enters per op class
definitions.dcoop: (coop_X(loop) - coop_X(rgm136 gemmL)) with coop_X = 1 when the loop loads operand X with tensor_coop groups (8 minions for A, 4 for B), else 0: -1 for gemmLnc, 0 for rgm136 gemmL, rgm211 gemmL and rgm211 gemmLn
definitions.units: gamma dimensionless; T_coop in cycles of the minion clock, added to D (divided by f)

pin_sets.gamma_3 / gamma_A / gamma_B (L3 part): training points of a loop with dT_path != 0 (rgm211 gemmLn, rgm211 gemmL, gemmLnc) at footprint <= 48 MB
pin_sets.gamma_F / gamma_A / gamma_B (fresh part): training points of such a loop at footprint > 32 MB
pin_sets.Tcoop_3: training gemmLnc points at footprint <= 48 MB
pin_sets.Tcoop_F: training gemmLnc points at footprint > 32 MB
pin_sets.rule: a constant whose set is empty in a fold is pinned at 0 there and printed with the fold (gamma_A, gamma_B need both parts empty)

items.identified_by: E213 family P (as training data once scores-e213 is committed): at each of four one-stream shapes (3x1x3 inside the L3, 1x6x5 and 4x1x6 at the knee, 1x1x44 past the L3) one map and four codes - rgm136 gemmL (path to B 77.75 cycles), rgm211 gemmL (64.0), rgm211 gemmLn (28.0), gemmLnc (55.75, no cooperation) - so ln(T_loop / T_rgm136 gemmL) at a shape is the code-side term alone: rgm211 gemmL and gemmLn give the exposure by regime (gamma), gemmLnc against rgm211 gemmL (similar paths, cooperation on and off) gives T_coop by regime; a087 against a088 (gemmLnc / gemmL 1x1x1 int8) the L2 place; arm B's gemmLnc points k37-k40 against their gemmL twins the same on card 1; E211's rgm211 points and controls and its c01, c02 already in the data
rule: fit G0, Gplace, Goperand and Gcoop on all the data and on every LOEO fold of the time data (item 9), each from the starts of item 5
score: LOEO wall-cycle rms over the touched points (every point of a loop other than rgm136 gemmL: rgm211 gemmLn, rgm211 gemmL, gemmLnc), configuration twins excluded
the lowest score wins; within 0.25 points the form with fewer constants (G0 0, Gcoop 3, Gplace and Goperand 5); Gplace before Goperand at equal constants
guard: the winner's pooled LOEO wall rms over all points must not exceed G0's by more than 0.05 points, else G0
items.not_wanted_if: G0 wins the rule, or every constant of the winner sits within 1% of 0 in the all-data fit (reported as not identified)
reported: the per-shape ratios ln(T_loop / T_rgm136) of E211 and E213, measured beside each form

items.name: the subset layout: T7, the masked walk, its trace check, its fallback T7L
items.v3: no layout model; T7L (the fallback) lost v3's rule (4.64% against the primary form's 4.67%: within 0.05 points at equal constants, the primary kept); spread masks held out 6.74% vs v2form's 5.40%; E213 family M tests the gap

inputs: the mask (32 bits; shire s in row group s >> 2 of 8 and column group s & 3 of 4)
the kernel's C-block walk (mn: rgm136 gemmL, gemmLnc, rgm211 gemmL; nm: rgm211 gemmLn at MB, NB >= 2)
T7.computes: the chip's lock-step request stream with only the mask's shires: at every step (C block in the walk's order, row half r, kb, k < 32) each active shire of row group g and column group c asks the A tiles 2 (4 g + d) + r (d < 4) and the B tiles 8 c + p (p < 8) of that step, as map_e211.shire_ops numbers them; the step's distinct A and B tiles are the union over the active shires (an A tile shared by its row group's active shires, a B tile by its column group's); the C TensorStores are the active shires' C tiles of each half block. Exact LRU stack distances (map_e211's Fenwick method, second pass) give each request's distance; the fold's retention (r_A, r_B two-edge) gives each step's place shares; Q0, Q1 = the mean over steps of outer(pA, pB) per row half with the L2 model's hit shares (each shire's own line stream, unchanged by the mask); n_eff,3 and n_eff,F = the masked stream's L3-served and fresh distinct lines a step over the full chip's at the same shape and retention; X3 = 1 - chi3 (1 - n_eff,3), XF = 1 - chiF (1 - n_eff,F), each clipped at 0.05 as in v3; MM1-v3's row-imbalance term (eta) unchanged (steps 3 and 4 exactly as steps_3_4_exact states and frozen_code implements)
T7.applies_to: subset points (mask != 0xffffffff) of the gemmL family (gemmL, gemmLn, gemmLnc arms); full-chip points and run_gemm's c-arms keep v3's map and n/32 exactly

desk_precondition.rule: at mask 0xffffffff the walk's stream equals map_e211.chip_steps for both walks, request for request; a failed precondition makes the trace check NOT RUN (T7 stays out); v3.1's fit lane re-runs t7_v31.py --check at its start with every subset shape of its data (--extra-shapes), a failure there being a failed precondition

steps_3_4_exact: 3: engine_v3's procedure for rgm211 gemmLn (engine_v3.WalkShape.Qhalves) on the masked stream: per step each operand's mean retention over the step's requests (r_A one edge, r_B two edges at the fold's theta; each tile weighted by the number of active shires that ask it, the plain mean at every product mask); B's mean x zeta in row half 1 where NB is a power of two >= 4 and the full-chip footprint passes 32 MB (v3's rule); pA = [hA, (1 - hA) mA, (1 - hA)(1 - mA)], pB alike, hA and hB the L2 model's hit shares of that row half (map_e211.l2_model, unchanged by the mask), x r2 under T5r exactly where engine_v3 applies r2 at that arm's full-chip map (walk mn, KB <= 2, MB x NB >= 2; never on the nm walk); Q0, Q1 = the mean over the half's steps of outer(pA, pB)

4: n_eff,3 and n_eff,F = the masked stream's L3-served and fresh distinct lines a step (16 x (1 - h) x the sum over the step's distinct tiles of r(d), and of 1 - r(d); zeta and r2 as in step 3), averaged over the steps, over the same code's average at mask 0xffffffff (same shape, walk and theta), each min(1, ratio), 1 where the full-chip average is 0; X3 = 1 - chi3 (1 - n_eff,3), XF = 1 - chiF (1 - n_eff,F), each at least 0.05, replace v3's n/32; the row-imbalance term, T_C (at the full-chip footprint) and the rest of the op time unchanged; item 3's forms change only D_A, D_B per op class and compose with T7 unchanged

frozen_code.role: T7's only implementation; v3.1's fit imports it unchanged: T7Bank(points).arrays(theta, form) gives Q0, Q1, n_eff,3, n_eff,F at each T7 point in place of v3's Q0, Q1 and n/32 in X3 and XF; op_time = TimeEngine.predict with exactly those replacements (G0)

trace_check.data: lane v31-trace's sys_emu traces on aifoundry3 of two masks of one E212 layout pair (equal shire count, different layout) at a shape E212 ran, for each kernel it can trace, and verify-v31trace's verdict
pass_rule: (a) over the logged harts, with a minimum log set: the walk enables hart 0 of all 32 minions of every shire in the mask (hart 1 enters and returns; no other shire is launched); at each mask the traces log at least (i) every hart (all 64) of every shire the mask enables and (ii) every hart (all 64) of at least one shire it does not enable (one run per mask logging every hart of the chip also meets this); (a) holds when, at both masks, every logged hart 0 of an enabled shire issues tensor loads, no logged hart 1 issues one, and no logged hart of a shire outside the mask retires a U-mode instruction; a log set below the minimum leaves (a) undecided

(b) for every traced minion (a minion whose hart 0 is logged), the ordered sequence of its tensor-load requests (operand, tile index relative to the operand's base) over the traced window equals the walk's for that minion: zero mismatches
(c) per traced minion, the request counts by operand equal the walk's

PASS = (a), (b) and (c) at both masks, and verify-v31trace HOLDS (or HOLDS WITH FIXES with its fixes applied and the check re-run); FAIL = any mismatch; NOT RUN = the traces cannot show (a)-(c) (v31-trace NOT TRACED, TRACED WITH GAPS that leave one of them undecided, or a log set below (a)'s minimum), or T7's desk precondition failed

T7L.as_v3_declared: n/32 replaced by n_eff = (64 R/8 + 128 C/4) / 192 (R of 8 row groups, C of 4 column groups active; an A tile shared by a row group's shires, a B tile by a column group's) in X3 and XF, the map at the full chip's lines, no new constant

layout_classes.rule: for subset points only (a full-chip point, mask 0xffffffff, is in no class): n = 1: other; compact if n = 4 R (every active row group whole); else spread if R = min(8, n) (the shires in as many row groups as they can be); else other
layout_classes.v3_sets_agree: v3's compact (0xf, 0xff, 0xffff, 0xffffff) and spread (0x1111, 0x11111111, 0x33333333, 0x77777777) sets fall in the same classes
layout_classes.v3_other_reclassified: 8 of MM1-v3's 37 'other' subset points (masks 0xf000, 0xfff, 0xf0f0f0f, 0xf0f0f0f0, 0xffff0000) are compact under this rule (desk: compact 104, spread 37, other 29 of v3's 170 subset points); v3.1 and v3 refitted are scored on the same classes; v3's own LOLO sets REPORTED beside

rule: if the trace check is PASS: fit T7, T7L and v3's n/32 form on all the data and on every LOEO and LOLO fold; T7 enters v3.1 if its LOLO wall rms over all subset points is lower than both others' and its pooled LOEO wall rms is not more than 0.05 points above the best of the three; otherwise the next step decides

if FAIL or NOT RUN (or T7 lost the step above): T7 stays out; T7L against n/32 by v3's declared time rule (lower pooled LOEO wall rms over all points; within 0.05 points the fewer constants; equal constants, n/32)
reported: family M's measured spread among masks of one shire count beside each form
LOLO by class for all three forms

items.name: the time fit: starts, seeds, basins, tolerance
items.v3: six declared starts a fold; one start reached the lower (global) basin in 27 of 30 folds; ftol = xtol = gtol = 1e-8 stopped three folds short

starts.S0-S5: MM1-v3's six declared starts (fit_v3.STARTS) for its names, the new names' six declared values (below)
starts.S6-S17: 12 draws, numpy.random.default_rng(20261118).uniform over each constant's start box, names in sorted() order, one draw a name a start; recorded below as numbers (the fit uses the recorded numbers; re-drawing is a check)
starts.a_form_takes: the names it has; a pinned constant takes its pinned value
starts.S6-S17_draw_order: start-major: S6's value for each of the 27 names of the box table in sorted() order (every name, whatever a form uses), then S7's, and so on to S17; each value rounded to 6 decimals

optimizer.phase_1: scipy least_squares on forecast / measured - 1 of the wall op time, every training point weight 1, x_scale 'jac', diff_step 1e-4, ftol = xtol = gtol = 1e-8, at most 4,000 evaluations, each of the 18 starts
optimizer.phase_2: the three lowest phase-1 costs continued from their end points at ftol = xtol = gtol = 1e-12, at most 4,000 evaluations a leg, restarted from the last point while the cost falls by more than 1e-9 relative, at most 5 legs
optimizer.winner: the lowest phase-2 training cost; ties within 1e-9 relative to the lower start index
optimizer.basins: two continued solutions share a basin when their costs agree within 1e-6 relative; reported per fold: every start's phase-1 cost, status and evaluations, the three continued costs and held-out rms, the winner's start, and how many of the 18 phase-1 costs lie within 1e-3 relative of the winner's; a fold whose winner one start alone reached is flagged (no change of rule)

energy_fit.starts: 9: MM1-v3's three (the linear solve at kc 1, xi 1, m 1, eC 1, then kc / xi / m 1.05 / 0.5 / 1.2 and 0.95 / 0.9 / 2.0) and 6 draws numpy.random.default_rng(20261119).uniform over the boxes below; each start's linear constants from the linear solve at its nonlinear values, clipped into bounds (E1b's b2, d2 to >= 0)
energy_fit.optimizer: least_squares on (W - W_meas) / max(W_meas, 3 W), ftol = xtol = gtol = 1e-12, at most 3,000 evaluations; the lowest cost wins
energy_fit.time_inputs: each energy fold reads its own time fold's phase-2 winner (lines, op times, retention)
energy_fit.draw_order: start-major: E3's value for each of the seven names in sorted() order, then E4's, to E8; each rounded to 6 decimals

items.cost_estimate_desk: MM1-v3's record: one form, 32 fits x 6 starts in about 25 minutes on one core (about 8 s a start); so 18 starts plus phase 2 is about 2.5 minutes a fit, about 50 minutes for LOEO (20 fits) and 90 minutes for every fold of one form

items.name: the census's gemmLnc instruction energy
items.v3: census-v3.json gives gemmLnc -45.66 pJ a minion-op relative to rgm136 gemmL (the two removed tensor_coop issue slots not credited)

correction.rule: the census's own stated rule applied to every class: dE = sum over classes dn_c (e_c - cpi p_awake), tensor CSRs priced e_c = 0, so a removed CSR issue slot returns its awake share cpi p_awake
correction.label: desk arithmetic from census-v3.json (sha256 cad5250c...); no fit

items.rule: v3.1 reads census-v3.1.json = census-v3.json with gemmLnc's dE_instr_pJ_per_minion_op_vs_rgm136 set to -39.6393 and a note; the time paths (D_A, D_B) and every other loop unchanged; its sha256 recorded by the fit lane
items.size: about +6.0 pJ a minion-op, about 4 mW at 1,024 minions and a 1.5 us op (desk)

items.name: the new switch counts (lane v31-counts)
items.inputs_only: each count enters as S(fmt, kind, KB) (signal fin edges an op, lo, zero delay) and v (valid share) exactly as MM1-v3's counts do (energy_v3.counts), never fitted or adjusted
items.source: v31-counts' committed count tables (tools/matmul/mm1/v3.1/counts/), entering only if its re-count of two committed points matched and verify-v31counts HOLDS (or its fixes are applied); their sha256 recorded, from the committed counts/ folder at GitHub main, in v3.1's README inputs table and in its fit record at the fit's start, before any v3.1 residual on those kinds is read

footings.fp32: counted at GEMM accumulator states (gate level)
footings.fp16: estimated: RTL toggles x the fp32 gate/RTL ratio
footings.int8: counted around the arithmetic only (m_int8 carries the rest: a reading, not a count)

items.energy_calibrated_constant: b0 (J a fin edge), with m_fp16 and m_int8, fitted jointly with the other energy constants on every energy point whose kind has a committed count, as v3: one b0 for every card and kind; kappa = 1 / (m b0) reported
items.not_forecast: a kind with no committed count stays NOT FORECAST in energy (time forecast); never a nearest-kind guess
items.new_fit_data: E212's switch-pattern arms and plan and real tiles enter v3.1's energy fit once counted; E213's zeros, ones, sparse50 points as counted kinds
phi_precedence: MM1-v3's energy_v3.phi_of where it gives a value (zeros 0, random 1, ones, sparse50 and E210's kinds, unchanged)
else the mean of kinds_v3.phi over the kind's committed tile files (the tiles its runs delivered)
else kinds_v3.phi's generator law, only for a law it defines (randn, sparse50, sparse25, e37)
else no phi: the kind is NOT FORECAST in energy
